places.name: Turning Torso Tower
places.ai_summary: A modern architectural marvel and the tallest building in Scandinavia, offering stunning views of Malmö and the Öresund Strait.

places.place_tip: Visit during sunset for the best views.

places.name: Malmö Castle (Malmöhus Slott)
places.ai_summary: A historic castle housing museums and exhibitions, surrounded by beautiful gardens and a moat.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum exhibits for a deeper understanding of Malmö’s history.

places.name: Oresund Bridge (Øresundsbron)
places.ai_summary: A stunning bridge connecting Sweden and Denmark, offering breathtaking views of the Öresund Strait.
places.cost: Toll fee for vehicles; pedestrians and cyclists can cross for free

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from a distance; crossing by vehicle offers a unique perspective.

places.place_tip: Stop at the viewpoint on the Swedish side for the best photos.

places.ai_summary: A beautiful garden in Malmö, featuring a variety of plants, flowers, and walking paths.

opening_hours.notes: Well-maintained with seasonal flower displays.

places.ai_summary: A scenic promenade in Malmö, perfect for a leisurely walk or bike ride, with views of the waterfront.
